claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.operations
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The potion grants the effect of Detect Thoughts for 10 minutes with no concentration. The effect's core mechanic is an on-demand save-gated thought probe available as an action during the entire 10-minute window. This is an ongoing interactive operation (trigger: player spends action, effect: target makes Wis save DC 13, on fail: surface/deep thoughts revealed, on success: effect ends). ActivatedAbilityMechanics.phases only supports one-time resolution steps fired at activation; there is no operations field to express ongoing per-use interactions during the duration. OngoingEffectMechanics has operations: ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<OngoingOperation>, but that family is restricted to SpellMechanics — not available for MagicItemMechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain the effect of the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13) for 10 minutes (no Concentration required)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityHeader.earlyEndOnSave
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Thoughts ends early when a creature succeeds on the Wis save during the thought probe. This early-end trigger is tied to the outcome of an ongoing save, not to an action taken by the drinker (unlike the target_makes_attack_roll / target_deals_damage / target_casts_spell variants in DurationEndTrigger). The existing DurationEndTrigger variants do not cover 'target succeeds on the periodic save'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: save DC 13 — implicit from Detect Thoughts RAW: if the creature succeeds on the Wis save, it notices you are probing and the spell/effect ends
